createDescription: Discount codes are platform-side only in v1: the platform records the discounted amount. No provider-native coupon is created.
deleteDescription: This soft-disables the coupon. It stops validating immediately, but its redemption history is kept.
deleteNote: Redemptions already recorded stay visible in the coupon detail.
description: Platform discount codes: create a code, set its value and limits, see redemptions, disable it when it leaks.
detailLoadError: The coupon could not be loaded.
disableDescription: The code stops validating immediately. Its redemption history is kept.
formCodeHelp: Upper-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, 3–50 characters. The code can never be changed after creation.
formDiscountValueFixedHelp: Amount in major units, e.g. 10 = $10.00 off. Stored in minor units.
formFirstPurchaseOnlyHelp: When on, the code only applies to a customer's first purchase.
formMaxPerUserHelp: Leave empty for unlimited per user.
formMaxRedemptionsHelp: Leave empty for unlimited total redemptions.
formPlansHelp: Comma-separated plan ids. Leave empty for all plans.
noCouponsDescription: No coupons yet. Create the first code to offer a discount.
noCouponsFilteredDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
noRedemptionsDescription: Nobody has redeemed this coupon yet.
reviewDescription: Check the coupon before creating it. The code, discount type, and discount value can never be changed after creation.
statDiscounted30dDescription: Total discounted across {count} redemptions in the last 30 days
statRedemptions30dDescription: Successful redemptions in the last 30 days
title: Coupons
